catalog_record.title: Le Repos (Rest)
catalog_record.museum: Musée d’Orsay, deposited at Musée des Beaux-Arts de Pau
catalog_record.scan_source: Independent photogrammetric scan at Musée des Beaux-Arts de Pau; public Objaverse archive of the licensed Sketchfab model
catalog_record.note: An adult woman reclines on a cushioned bed with her arms behind her head. Boucher carved the marble in 1892; it entered the French national collection that year and has been deposited in Pau since 1978.
catalog_record.attribution: Le Repos, Alfred Boucher, 1892, marble. Musée d’Orsay RF 3896, deposited at Musée des Beaux-Arts de Pau. 3D scan by pattarrian, via Sketchfab / Objaverse, CC BY 4.0; processed by Atrium. Reduced the source mesh from 3,407,429 to 250,001 triangles and applied Draco compression. Retained source vertex colors; no cropping, reconstruction, rotation or physical scaling.

source_review.identity_assessment: Scan creator identifies Alfred Boucher,1892,marble,in Pau; official Orsay record confirms exact work deposited in Pau. Source reference matches the reclining nude on a cushioned bed.
source_review.content_assessment: Full-figure museum sculpture of an adult reclining female nude. Source visual shows mature adult proportions, a resting pose, and no sexual act, coercion, child, or animal. Suitable as historical sensual sculpture.
source_review.artwork_rights: 1892 composition publicly exhibited at the 1892 Salon; artist died 1934. Historical underlying artwork; separate scan licensed CC BY4.0. Museum photograph rights are not being relied on.
